turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have eighteen minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. I'd like to hear who decided that, and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Sit down, I'll stand. The zero is in the gradebook, Hale, so you can start with what you have besides a score from software.
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. You have a zero in the gradebook and a meeting I'm giving you eighteen minutes for, so what else do you have?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here, Hale? You entered a zero before anyone called me, and I'm still waiting to hear what it's based on.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Together" isn't a basis for a zero, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and I wasn't. Tell me what you actually have on the essay, or I'm going upstairs.
